jerk_definition: mean squared 2nd difference of the commanded force vector per control tick (jerk_proxy). Gate is a POST-HOC tag only (Run 170): fixed threshold 0.618 in classify(), score weight, never control. No veto, no retraction.
frozen_kernel: fine pitch 0.025 m, isotropic disc r_eff = min(hu,hv), contact stride 2 above 400 contacts
face_frozen: round cylinder r=0.32 (h 0.44) | elongated box halfExtents [0.34, 0.14, 0.12]; scrub patch fixed at half=0.20 side=0.18/0.12, so the head runs OFF the face once the face shrinks below patch + r_eff
patch_frozen: half_u 0.20 m, side_v 0.12 m (elongated) / 0.18 m (round), cell pitch CELL_M 0.05 m
backend_note: pybullet only: maniskill 3.0.1 PickCube-v1 has no actor friction API and no public mjModel handle, so the swept mu cannot reach its contact pair
